method: New complete AI translations reconstructed against recovered frozen English masters after repeated workspace loss. Each of the ten reconstructed pages was compared paragraph by paragraph during composition and semantically reviewed; structural checks below supplement, not replace, that review. No external translation API or human/professional review used.
